author: Spread
name: Gradient bar
description: A rounded bar with a cool-to-hot gradient, the value at its end and a caption below.
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 240 52"><style>.cap{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;fill:currentColor;opacity:.7}.num{font-family:'SF Pro Display',Inter,'Segoe UI',system-ui,sans-serif;font-weight:200;fill:currentColor;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.trk{fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-opacity:.12}.f{fill:url(#bg);transform-box:fill-box;transform-origin:left center;transform:scaleX(var(--v))}.big{font-size:26px;fill:#ff8a2a}[data-level="0"] .big,[data-level="1"] .big,[data-level="2"] .big,[data-level="3"] .big{fill:#3b82f6}.cap{text-anchor:start}</style><defs><linearGradient id="bg" gradientUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x1="4" y1="0" x2="164" y2="0"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#2f6bff"/><stop offset=".5" stop-color="#9b3cff"/><stop offset=".8" stop-color="#ff3b5c"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#ff9a2a"/></linearGradient><clipPath id="bc"><rect x="4" y="11" width="160" height="10" rx="5"/></clipPath></defs>
<rect x="4" y="11" width="160" height="10" rx="5" fill="currentColor" fill-opacity=".14"/><g clip-path="url(#bc)"><rect class="f" x="4" y="11" width="160" height="10"/></g>
<text x="176" y="27" class="num big">{{value}}</text><text x="4" y="46" class="cap" style="font-size:11px">{{label}}</text></svg>
